Title: Azure SQL—general availability updates for early November 2021

Body.Content:
In early November 2021, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Increased storage limit to 16 TB with Azure SQL Managed Instance for the General Purpose tier.
  • Use Azure AD only authentication for Azure SQL Database and Managed Instance to disallow SQL authentication.
  • Change the differential backup frequency of Azure SQL Databases to 12 or 24 hours.
  • Azure SQL Managed Instance enables resource mobility for moving instances across subnets.
  • Allow linking Azure SQL instances to Azure SQL Managed Instance with Azure AD authentication.
